actions.note: offered when state==='paid' (label Refund); also performed for state 'refunding' (label Send the refund, started from a wish). Sample sets state 'refunded' at once; the code comment says the payment should read Refunded only when the provider confirms. Full amount only, no partial. Writes a staff event on the payment record and on the wish's timeline; audit log. Failing states: not_found, not_allowed (state not paid/refunding).
actions.evidence: POST /v1/admin/payments/:ref/refund { reason } -> Payment. The server asks the provider for a full refund; the payment reads Refunded when the provider confirms. Written to the audit log, and to the wish's life.
